name: Uptime Monitor
description: Watch the things a NAS is supposed to keep alive: web apps, routers, printers, cameras and other servers. Uptime Kuma pings HTTP, TCP, DNS and ICMP endpoints on a schedule, keeps response-time history and notifies you by email, Telegram, Discord, ntfy or webhook when something goes down. The first visit creates the administrator account and locks the instance; the UI opens in its own EthOS window on port 3001.
author: SyncHot
changelog: 1.0.0: first release — Uptime Kuma 2.5.12 pinned, SQLite in a package volume that survives updates, web UI on port 3001 (own login, created on the first visit) and a container healthcheck. Monitors HTTP, TCP, DNS and ICMP targets and delivers alerts through its own notification integrations.
